checks.notes: The inventory remains useful evidence at unmeasured; it is not upgraded to pass without explicit complete discovery authority.
checks.rule: Maintain a bounded, exact and hash-bound ST message contract inventory; a bounded census is evidence but never proof of complete scanner coverage, so heuristic absence is unmeasured
checks.title: ST message sender and receiver inventory

checks.rule: A definite unpaired shipped ST_* message is P1; heuristic absence of unpaired messages is unmeasured, never pass
checks.title: Message lifecycle pairing

checks.rule: A field used with conflicting definite payload types for one message type is P1; heuristic absence of conflicts is unmeasured, never pass
checks.title: Message payload shape compatibility

checks.rule: Packaged shell, modules and shared runtimes must be byte/hash bound and reject unsupported protocol versions
checks.title: Packaged protocol and manifest binding

checks.rule: A definite undeclared parent/global contract use is P1; heuristic absence is unmeasured, never pass, because alias and computed access can evade the scan
checks.title: Declared parent and global contracts
